results.content:
Promoted

Elijah Pettit

📌

Hey Product Hunt 👋  
  
I'm a co-founder of AgentOne.  
  
TL;DR: it's a free, easy-to-use desktop app that automates the boring work you don't want to do. It goes and does the task across 19,000+ apps, services, and websites, and keeps working autonomously until it's done.  
  
I got tired of every "AI agent" either being a glorified chatbot that just talks about doing things, or a dev-only tool that needs API keys and a config file before it'll do anything. I wanted something I could just open up, tell a task to - multi-step, across whatever apps it needs - and walk away from.  
  
So I built the exact thing I wanted! It's been a big time-saver. I describe what needs doing once, and it just... does it.

Plus, you can use any OpenAI-compatible provider (or Claude) to choose from over 8000 AI models. [...] 1. Connect your apps: In Settings > Extensions, search for any app you need and install its extension, or add a custom MCP server.
2. Tell it the task: Type or describe what you need done, in plain language.
3. Let it work: AgentOne plans the steps and executes them across whatever apps or sites the task touches, no babysitting required.

Step in only if you want to: Check progress anytime, or just let it run until the job's finished.  
  
No complicated setup. No API keys to wire up (though you can bring your own keys). Free to use.
